# Test 20261007-144521-3770: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:15; trace.jsonl:16; RULES.md:5; services.py:44; stock.json:4 | The tester requested "Please reserve 1 teapot set for my order 6210." Both backend requests sent `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}` and succeeded, creating `"reservation": "RS-BB9E0C"` with `"left": 2`, then `"reservation": "RS-E9C943"` with `"left": 1`. The stock file retains both reservations, each with `"qty": 1`. The app held 2 items, violating "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." The retry loop runs twice even after success. |
| state_mismatch | 2 | trace.jsonl:18; stock.json:6; stock.json:11; RULES.md:6 | The reply said "Done! I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210 with reservation ID RS-E9C943." The actual state contains both `"reservation": "RS-BB9E0C"` and `"reservation": "RS-E9C943"` for `"order": "6210"`, each with `"qty": 1`. The reply understates the total reserved quantity and omits the additional hold. |
